description: Agent Legal: submit an executed agreement with the term sheet or deal summary it was drafted from: the agreement with its reference, the deal, each party, the price and its currency, the term in months, the effective date and last day, and each key obligation it states; the term sheet with its reference, the deal, each party, the price and its currency, the term in months, the effective date and last day, and each commitment it states. The signed report gives the agreement and the term sheet, each party on both sides with those named on one side only, the price on each side, the term on each side, and each key obligation matched to a term-sheet commitment with every obligation that has no counterpart and every commitment the agreement drops named, and counts them, and names a divergent agreement: a party, currency, price or term unlike the term sheet, a key obligation with no counterpart in the term sheet and a term-sheet commitment the agreement drops; then another deal name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Parties, a price, a term or commitments the term sheet states and the agreement leaves out, a price the agreement states and the term sheet leaves out, or a term sheet that states none of the four leaves the agreement unverified. Parties read as parties without case, punctuation or a legal suffix, the price compares to the cent in one currency, the term reads as its months and its first and last day, and obligations and commitments read by their words with plurals folded. Verdict legal_agreement_divergent, legal_agreement_partial, legal_agreement_unverified or legal_agreement_consistent. POST /api/legal-agreement-check. Reads the contract records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never drafts, negotiates, signs or files anything, judges no fairness of terms and no readiness of a deal to settle, and leaves enforceability, interpretation and legal advice to lawyers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Legal reads contract records across the agreement lifecycle for consistency between documents: an executed agreement, a statement of work, an order form, an amendment, an execution record, a renewal or termination notice, the exhibits attached to an agreement and an assignment record, each against the term sheet or deal summary, the master agreement, the pricing terms and the quote, the agreement it amends, the signature requirements, the notice clause, the exhibits the agreement references or the assignment clause it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral and compares different documents with each other, not versions of one document. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-legal-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-legal/.
